scenarios.name: Bypass Role Authorization Check
scenarios.description: Mutate `require_system_roles` to bypass role evaluation and allow VIEWER access to privileged APIs.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: assert 200 == 403 (Privileged mutation permitted to VIEWER role)

scenarios.name: Invert Scope Exclusion Decision
scenarios.description: Invert exclusion logic so that targets matching scope exclusions are evaluated as permitted.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: assert target.is_authorized is False (Exclusion failed to override inclusion)

scenarios.name: Bypass Target Preflight Verification
scenarios.description: Mutate assessment engine to skip target authorization validation prior to scanner dispatch.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: Job status RUNNING instead of REJECTED for unauthorized target

scenarios.name: Always-Valid Evidence Checksum
scenarios.description: Mutate evidence verification to return valid=True regardless of cryptographic hash mismatches.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: assert result.valid is False (Tampered evidence passed verification)

scenarios.name: Skip Audit Predecessor Hash Chaining
scenarios.description: Mutate audit verification to omit checking that predecessor_hash matches prior event SHA-256.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: assert 'audit_chain_valid': False in drill report

scenarios.name: Bypass Remediation Approval Gate
scenarios.description: Allow remediation execution without checking `is_approved == True`.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: Unapproved remediation transitioned to EXECUTING

scenarios.name: Recycle Original Evidence in Independent Retest
scenarios.description: Mutate retest engine to reuse original scanner evidence instead of executing genuine verification scan.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: Finding remained VERIFIED_FIXED despite active vulnerability recurrence

scenarios.name: Ignore Broken Foreign Keys on Database Restore
scenarios.description: Mutate restore drill to ignore foreign key integrity check `PRAGMA foreign_key_check` failures.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: Corrupted database with broken foreign keys declared PASSED

scenarios.name: Permit Loopback IPv4 in Outbound SSRF Guard
scenarios.description: Mutate network validator to exclude `127.0.0.1` and `localhost` from loopback blacklist.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: SSRFSecurityError not raised for http://127.0.0.1:8000/internal

scenarios.name: Bypass HMAC Manifest Signature Invalidation
scenarios.description: Mutate release verifier to ignore cryptographic HMAC mismatch on modified release packages.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: assert res.signature_valid is False failed

scenarios.name: Bypass Cross-Tenant Project Membership Check
scenarios.description: Mutate object access control to allow users access to projects where they have no membership.

scenarios.name: Ignore Token Revocation Timestamp
scenarios.description: Mutate authentication dependency to skip checking `user.token_revoked_before`.

scenarios.name: Bypass Anti-Expansion Guard on Asset Ingestion
scenarios.description: Mutate attack surface service to directly authorize newly observed external endpoints.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: proposal is None (Unauthorized target not routed to inclusion proposal inbox)

scenarios.name: Bypass Path Traversal Directory Sanitization
scenarios.description: Mutate bundle export extraction to allow directory traversal paths like `../../etc/passwd`.
scenarios.observed_failure: AssertionError: PathTraversalSecurityError not raised for malicious archive
